title: Commerce Expo — Event Recap (long-form, landscape)

audio_bed.note: Empty/duckable stereo AAC bed sized to the video. Drop music in later. Natural sound preserved in source clips if you want a nat-sound pass instead.

portrait_treatment: pad_blur (blurred pillarbox) — vertical clip full-height center, blurred zoomed copy fills side bars. Preserves booth signage; consistent across the cut.

transition_legend.matchcut: short 0.2s dissolve where on-screen motion lines up (walking->walking, laptop->laptop)
transition_legend.dipblack: dip to black at act boundaries
transition_legend.dipwhite: dip to white into a brighter scene
